boundaries: The campaign has eighteen frozen cells: six independent repository tasks multiplied by three repetitions.
Round-robin order is fixed before execution and a failed cell is retained without success-based retry.
All cells must use one clean harness revision, the same model identity, the same task contracts, and the same request cap.
The candidate-informed adversarial follow-up is excluded because it is not an independent repository sample.
A completed campaign measures this frozen model and harness combination, not general software-engineering ability.
Token-derived cost is not a billing receipt.
